title: Hylian Homeowner
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW Hylian Homeowner.png }} |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Bolson]] |location= Hateno Village |prereq= |reward= [[Link's House]] |previous= |next= {{Color BotW|Side Quest|[[From the Ground Up]]}} }} "{{Term/Store|Hylian Homeowner||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Hylian Homeowner}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Hateno Village}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== Behind the [[Link's House|abandoned house]] in [[Hateno Village]], Link can find [[Bolson]].{{Cite|Need something from me?|Bolson|BotW}} If [[Link]] asks what he is doing, Bolson explains that he is demolishing the building, as nobody wants to live in it.{{Cite|[What're you doing?] In case it's not obvious, I'm demolishing a vacant house. Time are rough. Not a lot of buyers, y'know? So the villagers decided it was best to just tear it down.|Bolson|BotW}} Link can offer to buy the house, though Bolson is suspicious of his ability to do so.{{Cite|[I can buy it!] {{Small|Whoa, get a load of young moneybags... Just wants to "buy" it, huh?}}|Bolson|BotW}} Bolson informs Link that the house has been vacant for years,{{Cite|Okey-doo... Let me lay it out for you. See this house? Been vacant for years.|Bolson|BotW}} and the people of Hateno Village decided to pay [[Bolson Construction]] 50,000 [[Rupee]]s to take it down.{{Cite|So the villagers had a meeting, argued, voted, and decided to tear it down. The demolition costs, with associated fees, and other such details...come in at {{Color BotW|Red|50,000 rupees}}.|Bolson|BotW}} Therefore, to buy the house, Link would need to pay that amount.{{Cite|So when you say you want to "buy" it, you're talking about {{Color BotW|Red|50,000 rupees}}... You got that much on you?|Bolson|BotW}} However, he decides to lower the cost to 3,000 Rupees and 30 bundles of [[Wood]].{{Cite|... ...Alright. All right, look. Here's the deal! Just for you! I'll cut you a special price of {{Color BotW|Red|3,000 rupees}}. {{Big|BUT IN RETURN!}} I'm going to need you to bring me {{Color BotW|Red|30 wood bundles}}. Building materials... You know how it is.|Bolson|BotW}}{{Note|If Link is able to pay the 50,000 Rupees, Bolson will be surprised and remarks that he reminds him of himself in the past.{{Cite|Well! Who would have thought?! ...Little go-getter, aren't you? Heh. Reminds me of me back in the day.|Bolson|BotW}} However, he still offers Link the deal.}} Once Link is aware of the terms,{{Cite|Anyway, you understand the terms? Then get to it. And show me what you're built out of. ...That's a construction joke.|Bolson|BotW}} Bolson stops [[Hudson]] and [[Karson]]'s demolition work.{{Cite|Hudson! Karson! Stop what you're doing!|Bolson|BotW}} This begins the [[Side Quest]]. After Link has gathered the Wood bundles, he can return to Hateno Village to deliver them.{{Cite|[I'll pay your price!] ♪Okey-doo.♪ I'll grab them from you.|Bolson|BotW}} He realizes that Link is serious about the house and agrees to accept the 3,000 Rupee payment.{{Cite|All I needed to see... Good-faith wood. You're obviously serious about this, and now I know it. So, as promised, I'll sell you this old house for the low price of {{Color BotW|Red|3,000 rupees}}. Once you've got the money together, come grab me.|Bolson|BotW}} When Link is able to pay the 3,000 Rupees, Bolson is at first shocked to hear that he is not lying.{{Cite|Seriously?! You're really gonna give me {{Color BotW|Red|3,000 rupees}}? Like, with three zeroes? You aren't just posturing?|Bolson|BotW}} If Link asserts his willingness, Bolson will accept the payment.{{Cite|[I'll shell out!] ♪Now way!♪ Talk about studly! ♪I'll just take that off your hands.♪|Bolson|BotW}} He thanks Link for his investment and compliments his ability to spend so much money at his age.{{Cite|Thanks for the sweet investment. Spending so much money on ANYTHING at your age... It's just so...studly!|Bolson|BotW}} As a housewarming gift, Bolson allows Link to keep the [[Weapon Mount]] inside that never sold.{{Cite|There's a {{Color BotW|Blue|weapon mount}} in there that never sold... Consider it a housewarming gift. Hope you get some use out of it.|Bolson|BotW}} Bolson remarks that he has a [[From the Ground Up|job]] lined up in [[Akkala]] for [[Hudson]],{{Cite|So...next-job time, baby! What'd I have lined up again? Oh, yeah, {{Color BotW|Red|that's}} what's next. I was going to send Hudson up {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala}} way to clear some land!|Bolson|BotW}} which involves clearing some land.{{Cite|I asked Hudson to clear some land in the {{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala}} region.|Bolson|BotW}} If Link wants to say anything to Hudson, he should speak to him before he leaves.{{Cite|Yup... Business expansion, y'know. I'll probably have him head out soon. If you want to say anything to Hudson, better catch him before he leaves.|Bolson|BotW}} After Hudson has left, Bolson suggests that it is time for the two of them to relax.{{Cite|So the both of us sort of hit a personal milestone, huh? Time to kick back and get LEISURELY, baby!|Bolson|BotW}} However, from Link's face, Bolson realizes that he thinks they should continue to work on the house,{{Cite|...Though you look a bit judgemental for such a fine moment. You're looking at me like we should both keep working at it.|Bolson|BotW}} specifically addressing the fact that the house is empty.{{Cite|Heh! You don't even have to say it. "Oh, wah, I just bought a house and it's totally empty and depressing!" Oh, sure, that's you to a T. I see it in your eyes. Yup, I was just like you, about a lifetime ago.|Bolson|BotW}} He offers to take care of additions for 100 Rupees.{{Cite|So tell you what, lemme help by taking care of furniture, or the exterior, or anything really, for {{Color BotW|Red|5,000 rupees}}. Actually, no, scratch that. For you? Let's start at {{Color BotW|Red|100 rupees}}.|Bolson|BotW}} The list of each addition is as follows: {| class="wikitable" style="width:22em; max-width:100%;text-align: center" !style="width:50%"| Object !style="width:50%"| Quantity |- ! colspan=2 | Gear Display |- | ''[[Weapon Mount]].'' | 2 |- | ''[[Bow Stand|Bow Mount]].'' | 3 |- | ''[[Shield Stand|Shield Mount]].'' | 3 |- ! colspan=2 | Installations |- | ''[[Bed]].'' | 1 |- | ''Lighting.'' | 1 |- | ''Door.'' | 1 |- ! colspan=2 | House Exterior |- | ''A sign with my name!'' | 1 |- | ''Plant some flowers!'' | 1 |- | ''Plant trees!'' | 1 |} The total cost of all the additions is 1,400 Rupees. Once Link has purchased all of the additions, Bolson will be surprised by his drive.{{Cite|{{Big|AHH! YOU HOUSING MONSTER!}} You got EVERYTHING?! Ah, such is the way of youth... Driven! Even reckless, some might say.|Bolson|BotW}} As a reward, he adds extra [[Furniture]] to Link's House, such as a dining table, storage boxes underneath the staircase and a cabinet.{{Cite|Well, since you bought everything, I threw in some free {{Color BotW|Blue|furniture}}! Yeah! Least I could do! {{Big|Karson! Look lively!}}|Bolson|BotW}} This will complete the Side Quest, leaving Bolson to wonder how Hudson's expansion project is doing.{{Cite|House is absolutely perfect... Nothing else I can do to improve it. Come to think of it, we've had no word from Hudson, have we? Hard to believe someone could get lost on a simple trip to {{Color BotW|Blue|Lake Akkala}}...|Bolson|BotW}} ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | You can buy a house in Hateno Village!

Bolson, president of Bolson Construction, offered to slash his original asking price of {{Color BotW|Red|50,000 rupees}} down to {{Color BotW|Red|3,000 rupees}} if you also throw in 30 bundles of wood.

What are you waiting for? Gather the wood and bring it to him! |- | 2 | You gave Bolson his wood and got him to slash his asking price for an old-fashioned home from {{Color BotW|Red|50,000 rupees}} to {{Color BotW|Red|3,000 rupees}}.

When you have the {{Color BotW|Red|3,000 rupees}} saved up, talk to Bolson again to close the deal. |- | 3 | You bought a house in Hateno Village for {{Color BotW|Red|3,000 rupees}}! Bolson generously furnished a weapon rack inside your empty home as a housewarming gift.

The place is still pretty bare, though. If you talk to Bolson, he might be able to help you with that. |- | 4 | Bolson offered to sell you furniture! Not only that, he'll also remodel your home's exterior!

Renovate your home with furniture and style to be the envy of your new neighbors! |- | Complete | You ordered lots of furniture and exterior knickknacks, and your house is finally a home.

Bolson seems pretty relieved to have finished such a big job. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bolson * Bolson Construction * Hateno Village * Link's House }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
